decision.primary_evidence: M384 r1b; r1 is retained but superseded because its prose reversed the already-correct LSB0 field description and overstated legal fault recovery
decision.rationale: The exact-SHA r1b evidence and both manifest layers verify. Fresh VCS replay reproduces the receipt and assertion report byte-for-byte, all 18 named coverpoints remain nonzero, 10 directed protocol attacks remain fail-closed, and the PASS payload remains 4 phases, 8 replays, 10,804 checked bundles, 14 PWP runs and zero numeric/order mismatch. Independent source and executable audits find no P0/P1 in descriptor packing, compaction, run/address generation, prefetch gating, D8 credit or replay extent. Only exploratory controller-logic DC is admitted.

verified_gates.fresh_sim_log_nonlogical_differences: absolute output path, wall-clock timestamp and CPU time only

descriptor_and_numeric_audit.canonical_layout_lsb0: [11:0] row_id, [27:12] original, [34:28] center_id, [39:35] distance, [40] use_pwp, [47:41] reserved zero

findings.title: Several requested fail-closed cases are source-proved rather than separate dynamic VCS attacks
findings.detail: The frozen VCS test dynamically attacks bad row/order/center/distance/use, wrong replay tile, corrupted reserved flags/address, third replay and an unsolicited response. Wrong prefetch tag/bank, completion before start, duplicate/post-done completion and wrong response tag/bank are independently confirmed by the exact combinational fault predicates, but do not each have a named dynamic test in r1b. Add them before signoff-quality verification; this does not block exploratory logic-only DC.

findings.title: Nearest and lowest-ID q32 center selection remains outside this controller
findings.detail: M384 checks center_id<32, recomputes distance to the supplied center and enforces the strict use rule. It deliberately does not integrate the q32 matcher or prove that the supplied center is the global nearest/lowest-ID tie winner. The upstream matcher boundary must remain explicit.

findings.title: The frozen VCS log does not retain a per-cycle request-address trace
findings.detail: D8 fullness, L1/L2/L4/L8, 8,216 simultaneous response/bundle cycles and zero response stalls are covered. RTL inspection proves request_valid is directly gated only by replay state, remaining count, credit and safety, so there is no hidden serialized descriptor stage. The exact longest continuous accepted-request streak cannot be recovered from the aggregate log and should be emitted in a future trace.

findings.title: Descriptor and PWP SRAMs remain external behavioral interfaces
findings.detail: The controller enforces logical 1RW phase separation, in-order responses, alignment, bounds and credit. It does not instantiate or characterize a physical SRAM macro, shared-port arbitration, wiring or clock tree. M387 may synthesize controller logic only and must preserve physical_descriptor_sram=false and physical_pwp_sram=false.

findings.title: Directed controller verification is not the frozen 17,280-phase performance miter
findings.detail: Four normal phases cover active counts 0/1/2400/3000 and eight legal replays, but they do not replay all frozen PAFT phases or establish the M381 recurrence in RTL cycles. No system speedup, headline, energy or paper-PPA claim follows from M384/M385.

dc_required_boundaries: Use exact M384 r1b source and M385 seal; r1 is superseded evidence, not the DC input
Controller logic only at 3.0 ns with external descriptor/PWP SRAM interfaces
No physical SRAM, wire, clock-tree, energy, system-speedup or paper-PPA claim
Report check_design, unresolved references, latches, timing loops, setup/hold and exact source hashes fail-closed
Do not convert directed coverage counts into workload or performance populations
